facts.fact: The Minister of State for Health said on 13 November 2025 that the SORMAS disease surveillance platform is deployed in all 36 states, with 96% of local government areas 'now connected' and able to report in real time; he does not say the reporting is done at the local government's own office.
facts.system: SORMAS reporting link of local government areas

facts.fact: The Minister of State for Health said on 13 November 2025 that 96% of local government areas are connected to the SORMAS disease surveillance platform and able to report in real time; he gives no numerator or denominator, and does not say how or where they are connected.
facts.system: SORMAS reporting link of local government areas

systems.owner: not stated; cited by the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare
systems.tiers: deployed in all 36 states; 96% of local government areas connected and reporting in real time

note: Parent to weigh: the two facts rest on one sentence about a health surveillance platform. It states local government areas are 'connected' and report in real time into a national system, which the study file reads as a connection; it does not state that this is at the local government's own office, who provides the link, or the count behind 96%. No value is recorded for how the office is connected.
